items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Advanced Degree
Drives motorized equipment: Yes
6 - 10 years of related experience.
Minimum of 4 years of experience frontline major-gift fundraising.
Fundraising, institutional advancement, or strategic business development within higher education, academic medicine, or a similarly complex, multi-layered nonprofit organization.
Experience engaging advisory boards and volunteer leaders as donors and champions of philanthropic priorities.
Develops and manages dynamic portfolio to identify, qualify, cultivate, solicit and steward prospects for gifts in the agreed upon range. May include corporate and foundation prospects. (65% time)

Fundraising strategy, proposals, and philanthropic counsel: Personally, develops and executes sophisticated cultivation and solicitation strategies and serves as the philanthropic advisor to donors, connecting donor interests to the unit’s highest priorities. Develops clear, donor-centered proposals and related solicitation materials, coordinating academic, programmatic, financial, and gift-administration input as needed. Advises the unit fundraising lead and academic partners on fundraising strategy, helps translate priorities into compelling funding opportunities, and leads assigned fundraising initiatives within the unit’s broader plan. Provides fundraising leadership to advisory boards and key volunteers, engaging members as donors and building their focus on and efforts toward growing the philanthropic support of the unit. (15% time)

Team Operating Practices: Collaborates with unit faculty, staff, leadership, and central DAE colleagues on donor strategy and fundraising initiatives. Partners with Donor Relations and Stewardship on donor impact reporting and recognition. Shares expertise with colleagues. Represents the unit and UCR at donor, alumni, and community events and on committees as assigned, using events to advance portfolio strategies. (10% time)

Other Duties: Maintains timely, accurate contact reports, prospect plans, proposals, and forecasts in the CRM. Participates in ongoing professional development. May oversee the work of volunteers, student workers, or support staff. Performs related duties as assigned. (10% time)
Required to hold valid driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program.
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Frequently
Bend: Occasionally
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Frequently
Walk: Frequently

Advanced written, oral and interpersonal communication skills, including political acumen, to establish and maintain good working relationships throughout the organization and with outside constituencies. Ability to make persuasive and compelling presentations of goals and objectives for a location in order to secure gifts.
Ability to conceptualize, design, and lead a unit development program, setting strategy and goals in partnership with the dean or unit head.
Very strong skills in maintaining confidentiality.

Advanced working knowledge of all aspects of the location, including current issues of concern for both the campus and/or throughout higher education/healthcare generally. Advanced working of the location, its vision, mission, goals, objectives, achievements and infrastructure.
Advanced knowledge of applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies, etc.

Advanced organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills, including skill in creative and effective decision-making and problem identification/avoidance/resolution, and strong project management skills.
Advanced knowledge of all aspects of fundraising, donor relations, and public relations concepts, principles, procedures, and techniques.
Ability to build a donor pipeline, independently plan and manage portfolio activity to meet annual expectations for visits, qualifications, solicitations, and gift production.
Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and standard productivity software; maintains timely, accurate data entry of contact reports and prospect plans.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a matrix, centralized-decentralized development model.
